g.text: DOC concentration, variability and seasonal response
Deduplicated source-training DOC cells (142 / 143 / 144); each eligible station contributes once.
Points: class medians; intervals: 95% station-bootstrap intervals (2,000 draws). Seasonal lines: station means with pointwise intervals.
Station eligibility: ≥12 DOC months and ≥6 calendar months. C–Q additionally needs ≥24 paired DOC–flow months.
